usage.summary:
Implemented the producer, local transport, regressions and documentation. Hooks use a pinned testing-source overlay and an independent event pipe.

Factory run 3 passes formatting, vet and all tests except `TestLocalGoTransportOwnsChannelsAndResources`: it expects `go env GOENV` to report `"off"`, but Go reports `""` when configuration is disabled. A new real-process regression confirms the child receives `GOENV=off`.

Passing requires correcting that immutable assertion outside this build’s scope. I preserved opaque output and left the acceptance test unchanged.

The merger must still confirm D-0321 and record the producer/transport decision.
